---
params:
  country_code: "TK"
  report_year: 2025
  refresh_data: false
format:
  pdf:
    pdf-engine: xelatex
    mainfont: "Times New Roman"
    template-partials:
      - before-body.tex
    documentclass: SCreport
    fontsize: 11pt
    geometry:
      - margin=1in
    toc: true
    number-sections: true
    link-citations: true
    colorlinks: true
    linkcolor: SCblue
    filecolor: SCblue
    urlcolor: SCblue
    citecolor: SCblue
    toccolor: SCblue
    highlight-style: github
    code-block-bg: "#f6f8fa"
    code-block-border-left: "#c5c5c5"
    code-font: "Consolas, Monaco, 'Andale Mono', monospace"
    filters:
      - inline-code.lua
    include-in-header:
      - text: |
          \usepackage{float}
          \makeatletter
          \let\DeclareUnicodeCharacter\@gobble
          \makeatother
          \floatplacement{figure}{H}
          \floatplacement{table}{H}
      - R/preambles/preamble_active.tex
    header-includes: |
     \usepackage{xcolor}
     \usepackage{eso-pic}
     \definecolor{inlinecodecolor}{RGB}{40, 44, 52}
     \definecolor{inlinecodebg}{RGB}{245, 245, 245}
     \let\oldtexttt\texttt
     \renewcommand{\texttt}[1]{\colorbox{inlinecodebg}{\textcolor{inlinecodecolor}{\oldtexttt{#1}}}}
---

```{r report-setup, include=FALSE}
country_code <- toupper(params$country_code)
report_year  <- params$report_year
refresh_data <- isTRUE(params$refresh_data)

source("R/config.R")
generate_preamble(country_code = country_code, report_year = report_year)

source("R/data_prep.R")
```
